body:
~6 git spawns happen before any command logic: rev-parse --show-toplevel, rev-parse --git-common-dir, branch --show-current, and rev-parse HEAD twice (base_head is computed in Tracker.__init__ and again in Tracker.open after migrations).

Cheap wins:
- `git rev-parse --show-toplevel --git-common-dir` answers two questions in one call (one line each on stdout)
- drop the duplicate head read by threading the value through (the post-migration re-read in open() is the one that must stay)

Roughly 10-20ms per invocation on the Pi. Follow-up in the same vein as T-150. Verify with: strace -f -e trace=execve ./scripts/gittoc summary
title: Reduce startup git subprocess count in Tracker.open
